components.spec: button, a simple rim and at most one small accent, no clusters of ornaments, ornaments mirrored symmetrically, left and right halves matching

avatar frame, a distinct rim with a few ornaments at the corners, the body itself left clear, ornaments mirrored symmetrically, left and right halves matching, fully opaque everywhere, alpha 255, with no see-through part at all, whatever material it may look like

the fill bar that sits inside the progress bar, the same length and corner radius, with no track or frame of its own, clean silhouette: a plain edge with no rim ornament and NO decorative objects attached — no flowers, lanterns, ribbons, gems or trinkets on or around it
